I have several serious diagnosed illnesses
In recent years there has been several changes ...in ownership new doctors and practice management However....

Doctors
The good quality of care has remained consistent I can always access a consultation no matter which doctor I see I am listened to my opinion is always considered in my treatment the care is excellent. The doctors make me feel safe they are all knowledgeable and do not delay in referring to hospitals or for necessary further tests. I must inform you that I am a complex patient as I said I have several serious conditions I tend to be non compliment with medication as I do get many side effects but I am always treated with respect and never made to feel like a nuisance.

Receptionists

All the receptionists at Padgate Medical Centre are efficient knowledgeable respectful kind and helpful they take great effort to understand my needs and alleviate my fears absolutely first class

I have also been impressed with the nursing staff the mental health services and the pharmacist

The surgery is pleasant and spotlessly clean a job very well done

Thanks to all
Pauline is very frustrating trying to see a doctor.
They have an online appointment system that displays appointments for the next 2 weeks - but it always states there are no appointments available. And I mean always, not sometimes, but 100% all the time.
So, you have to ring them at 8am for an appointment that day, and of course it takes a number of attempts to get through, because everyone has been told to ring at the same time. It’s quite stressful actually.
God knows how the receptionist staff deal with it, knowing that the minute they start work they’re going to get bombarded with people, all frustrated, all requesting an appointment that they can’t give them. They must hate coming in to work, I couldn’t do their job that’s for sure.
But you know what, change the system! Make it easier! It would be better for their staff and their patients.
So, the 8am call... It can take a long time for the phone to be answered, by which point there are no doctor appointments left. I have never managed to see a doctor this way, and I’ve been a patient here for about 5 years.
They can offer an “advanced nurse” appointment, if they have any of those left. Which of course you accept, because the alternative is to try again at 8am tomorrow.
When I do get in, I would suggest the service is around 3 stars. Friendly enough, but limited previous notes or history is available, and I’m the one explaining previous diagnosis, medication and so on. Certainly not the place for someone who needs proper care and attention eg someone with memory problems. And not the place for someone who suffers from anxiety either, as the stress of booking an appointment could add to their problems.
So, I would say 3 stars for the service, 1 star for trying to make an appointment.
Overall, 2 stars.
